description: This file defines the LocationActivity class for an Android app, demonstrating how to incorporate location-based services, handle location updates from GPS and network providers, perform reverse geocoding, and manage UI updates related to location data.

classes.name: LocationActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling location updates, UI updates, and reverse geocoding in the Android app.

classes.name: EnableGpsDialogFragment
classes.description: Dialog fragment prompting the user to enable GPS when it is disabled.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, and sets up UI components and location handler.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state to handle configuration changes like rotation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up location updates when the activity comes to foreground.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks if GPS is enabled; prompts the user to enable it if not.

methods.name: enableLocationSettings
methods.description: Launches intent to open location settings screen.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes location updates when activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures location update subscriptions based on user selection (fine, both).

methods.name: requestUpdatesFromProvider
methods.description: Requests location updates from specified provider, shows message if not supported.

methods.name: useFineProvider
methods.description: Handler for the button that enables only GPS location updates.

methods.name: useCoarseFineProviders
methods.description: Handler for the button that enables both GPS and network location updates.

methods.name: doReverseGeocoding
methods.description: Performs reverse geocoding in background to convert coordinates to address.

methods.name: updateUILocation
methods.description: Updates UI with new location data, initiates reverse geocoding if available.

methods.name: getBetterLocation
methods.description: Compares two location objects to determine the most accurate/current one.

methods.name: isSameProvider
methods.description: Checks if two provider strings are the same.
